instruction: The prepared wrong_intermediate box is a known wrong result. Delete that object and replace it with one valid closed box named corrected on Parts, with world bounds (0,0,0) to (50,25,15) mm. The old wrong_intermediate object must be absent. Keep reference on Datum completely unchanged, including ID and attributes. Leave only corrected and reference, with no new layers. Match bounds within 0.001 mm and volume within 1%; objects must be visible and unlocked.
